function serializeConversation(messages){let parts=[];for(let msg of messages)if(msg.role==="user"){let content=contentText(msg.content,"");content&&parts.push(`[User]: ${content}`)}else if(msg.role==="assistant"){let toolCalls=[];for(let block of msg.content)if(block.type==="toolCall"){let args=block.arguments,argsStr=Object.entries(args).map(([k,v])=>`${k}=${JSON.stringify(v)}`).join(", ");toolCalls.push(`${block.name}(${argsStr})`)}msg.content.some(block=>block.type==="text")&&parts.push(`[Assistant]: ${contentText(msg.content)}`),toolCalls.length>0&&parts.push(`[Assistant tool calls]: ${toolCalls.join("; ")}`)}else if(msg.role==="toolResult"){let content=contentText(msg.content,"");content&&parts.push(`[Tool result]: ${truncateForSummary(content,TOOL_RESULT_MAX_CHARS)}`)}return parts.join(`

`)}
functions_and_methods.name: serializeConversation

functions_and_methods.raw_source: function extractFileOperations(messages,entries,prevCompactionIndex){let fileOps=createFileOps();if(prevCompactionIndex>=0){let prevCompaction=entries[prevCompactionIndex];if(!prevCompaction.fromHook&&prevCompaction.details){let details=prevCompaction.details;if(Array.isArray(details.readFiles))for(let f of details.readFiles)fileOps.read.add(f);if(Array.isArray(details.modifiedFiles))for(let f of details.modifiedFiles)fileOps.edited.add(f)}}for(let msg of messages)extractFileOpsFromMessage(msg,fileOps);return fileOps}
functions_and_methods.name: extractFileOperations

functions_and_methods.raw_source: function estimateProjectedContextTokens(projection,branchEntries){let estimate=estimateContextTokens(projection.messages);if(estimate.lastUsageIndex!==null){let projectedMessageIndex=0,usageEntryId;for(let entry of projection.entries){let nextMessageIndex=projectedMessageIndex+entry.messages.length;if(estimate.lastUsageIndex<nextMessageIndex){usageEntryId=entry.sourceEntry.id;break}projectedMessageIndex=nextMessageIndex}let usageEntryIndex=usageEntryId?branchEntries.findIndex(entry=>entry.id===usageEntryId):-1,latestInvalidatingEntryIndex=-1;for(let i=branchEntries.length-1;i>=0;i--){let entry=branchEntries[i];if(entry.type==="context_edit"||entry.type==="compaction"){latestInvalidatingEntryIndex=i;break}}if(usageEntryIndex>latestInvalidatingEntryIndex)return estimate}let currentSystem=getCurrentSystemMessage(projection.messages),tokens=currentSystem?estimateTokens2(currentSystem):0;for(let message of projection.messages)message.role!=="system"&&(tokens+=estimateTokens2(message));return{tokens,usageTokens:0,trailingTokens:tokens,lastUsageIndex:null}}
functions_and_methods.name: estimateProjectedContextTokens

functions_and_methods.raw_source: function estimateTextAndImageContentChars(content){if(typeof content=="string")return content.length;let chars=0;for(let block of content)block.type==="text"&&block.text?chars+=block.text.length:block.type==="image"&&(chars+=ESTIMATED_IMAGE_CHARS);return chars}
functions_and_methods.name: estimateTextAndImageContentChars

functions_and_methods.raw_source: function estimateTokens2(message){let chars=0;switch(message.role){case"system":{let system=message;if(chars=estimateTextAndImageContentChars(system.content),system.sections)for(let section of Object.values(system.sections))section&&(chars+=section.length);return system.toolsAdded&&(chars+=JSON.stringify(system.toolsAdded).length),Math.ceil(chars/4)}case"user":return chars=estimateTextAndImageContentChars(message.content),Math.ceil(chars/4);case"assistant":{let assistant=message;for(let block of assistant.content)block.type==="text"?chars+=block.text.length:block.type==="thinking"?chars+=block.thinking.length:block.type==="toolCall"&&(chars+=block.name.length+JSON.stringify(block.arguments).length);return Math.ceil(chars/4)}case"custom":case"toolResult":return chars=estimateTextAndImageContentChars(message.content),Math.ceil(chars/4);case"bashExecution":return chars=message.command.length+message.output.length,Math.ceil(chars/4);case"branchSummary":case"compactionSummary":return chars=message.summary.length,Math.ceil(chars/4)}return 0}
functions_and_methods.name: estimateTokens2
